notes: New look: icon side bar, reorganized Settings and a new wallpaper editor with live home preview.
New Search: one search bar, Recent / Top / Random / Pools, 16:9 cards with score and one-click Ae import. Downloaded clips get a green outline.
New Library: Compact View, Windows-style folders with S/M/L sizes and a cleaner Local tab with filters.
The welcome tour can install the optional tools and lets you choose where clips are saved.
The update screen now shows animated steps.
Changed: the clip menu is now a trash button, folder cover pictures were removed and SakugaRemap is hidden from Settings (still in Window > Extensions).
Fixed: total number of search pages, opening folders, the selection bar covering page buttons, long Pools names and the flicker while opening.
SHA256 and ZIP checks, size limits, one update at a time, automatic backup and rollback.
